messages.subject: From today's session: GAMs
parts:
Hi all,

Rosemary walked us through working with GAMs in R today for modeling organism presence/absence data. Her code is up at http://www.noamross.net/blog/2012/11/9/gams-for-drug.html

Ryan also added some info on using boosted regression trees, so look at his comments at the bottom of the page.

Noam
